card.name: Capital M starting a new word
card.fires_on: The letter M (or -m) that begins a word, usually right after a section heading like CONTRAINDICATIONS or DRUG INTERACTIONS, or in all-caps label text. The next letters are still to come.

modes.label: Drug name after heading
modes.description: A lone M starts a drug name right after a numbered section heading.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS<< M>>efenamic acid capsules are contrain

modes.label: All-caps M word
modes.description: An M begins a word in an all-caps warning, such as MIGHT or MALIGNANCY.
modes.example: FORMS OF THERAPY. DEATHS HAVE BEEN REPORTED WITH THE USE OF METHOTREXATE IN THE TREATMENT OF<< M>>ALIGNANCY, PSORIASIS

modes.label: M in general text
modes.description: An M begins a word like macular or Mars in ordinary prose.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter M of a word that is just beginning, especially a drug name after a section heading.
